name: RADIUM
recent: Radium Development 在2026年11月25日出现大股东与董事的股权变动申报，集团董事经理 Datuk Gan Kah Siong 于11月20日间接脱售4000万股（1.153%），每股作价0.500令吉。公司11月19日发布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，新闻指出第三季营收近乎翻三倍至1.333亿令吉，并录得1430万令吉净利。此外，Kepong 的 Radium Evara 项目录得40%认购率。
notable: 集团董事经理 Datuk Gan Kah Siong 间接脱售4000万股（1.153%），每股作价0.500令吉。
公司发布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，新闻指第三季营收近乎翻三倍至1.333亿令吉，净利1430万令吉。
Kepong 的 Radium Evara 项目录得40%认购率。
risks: 集团董事经理 Datuk Gan Kah Siong 间接脱售4000万股（1.153%），每股作价0.500令吉。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为7461.6万令吉，环比增长5.4%，同比增长75.2%；净利为700.5万令吉，环比增长51.5%，同比增长792.4%；净利率为9.4%，高于上一季度的6.5%。

recent_en: Radium Development saw shareholder and director interest change filings on 25 Nov 2026, with Group Managing Director Datuk Gan Kah Siong indirectly disposing 40 million shares (1.153%) at MYR 0.500 each on 20 Nov. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 on 19 Nov, with news reporting 3Q revenue nearly tripling to RM133.3 million and net profit of RM14.3 million. Radium Evara in Kepong also recorded a 40% take-up rate.
notable_en: Group Managing Director Datuk Gan Kah Siong indirectly disposed 40 million shares (1.153%) at MYR 0.500 each.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026, with 3Q revenue nearly tripling to RM133.3 million and net profit of RM14.3 million.
Radium Evara in Kepong recorded a 40% take-up rate.
risks_en: Group Managing Director Datuk Gan Kah Siong indirectly disposed 40 million shares (1.153%) at MYR 0.500 each.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was RM74.616 million, up 5.4% QoQ and 75.2% YoY; net profit was RM7.005 million, up 51.5% QoQ and 792.4% YoY; net margin was 9.4%, higher than 6.5% in the previous quarter.
